'''Francesco Rivella'''<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.ntn24.com/noticias-actualidad/fallecio-francesco-rivella-creador-del-producto-dulce-y-cremoso-mas-famoso-del-mundo-539942|title=Falleció Francesco Rivella, creador del producto dulce y cremoso más famoso del mundo &#124; NTN24.COM|website=NTN24}}</ref> (8 August 1927 – 14 February 2025) was an Italian [[chocolatier]] and [[chemist]] known for his work with the expansion of the [[Ferrero (company)|Ferrero]] brand, including the creation of the chocolate [[Spread (food)|spread]] [[Nutella]] and the development of its recipe.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.news18.com/world/francesco-rivella-father-of-nutella-passes-away-on-valentines-day-chocolate-hazelnut-spread-9231175.html|title=Francesco Rivella, Man Behind Your Favourite Nutella, Dies On Valentine's Day At 97|website=News18|access-date=18 February 2025|archive-date=18 February 2025|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250218035600/https://www.news18.com/world/francesco-rivella-father-of-nutella-passes-away-on-valentines-day-chocolate-hazelnut-spread-9231175.html|url-status=live}}</ref> 

==Life and career==
Rivella was born in [[Barbaresco (CN)|Barbaresco]], Piedmont, Italy, on 8 August 1927.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://gulfnews.com/world/europe/nutella-inventor-francesco-rivella-dies-at-97-1.500039162|title=Nutella inventor Francesco Rivella dies at 97|first=Gulf News|last=Report|date=17 February 2025|website=Gulf News: Latest UAE news, Dubai news, Business, travel news, Dubai Gold rate, prayer time, cinema|access-date=18 February 2025|archive-date=17 February 2025|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250217183910/https://gulfnews.com/world/europe/nutella-inventor-francesco-rivella-dies-at-97-1.500039162|url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Morto Francesco Rivella, il chimico che inventò la Nutella per Ferrero |url=https://www.ilgiornale.it/news/nazionale/morto-francesco-rivella-chimico-che-invent-nutella-ferrero-2438930.html |website=ilGiornale.it |access-date=18 February 2025 |language=it |date=16 February 2025 |archive-date=17 February 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250217192725/https://www.ilgiornale.it/news/nazionale/morto-francesco-rivella-chimico-che-invent-nutella-ferrero-2438930.html |url-status=live }}</ref> Having just received a degree in bromatological chemistry from [[Turin]],<ref name="fox">{{Cite web|url=https://www.foxnews.com/food-drink/father-nutella-worlds-famous-hazelnut-spread-dies-97|title='Father' of Nutella, world's most famous hazelnut spread, dies at 97|first=Peter|last=Burke|date=17 February 2025|website=Fox News|access-date=18 February 2025|archive-date=17 February 2025|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250217181943/https://www.foxnews.com/food-drink/father-nutella-worlds-famous-hazelnut-spread-dies-97|url-status=live}}</ref> Rivella began to work alongside the businessman [[Michele Ferrero]] as Ferrero's right hand man to produce chocolate beginning at the age of 25 in 1952,<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.grocerybusiness.ca/in-memoriam-father-of-nutella-francesco-rivella/|title=In Memoriam: 'Father of Nutella' Francesco Rivella|first=Mary|last=Scianna|date=17 February 2025|website=Grocery Business Magazine}}</ref> having joined the [[Ferrero (company)|Ferrero]] company as a [[chocolatier]].  The original form of [[Nutella]], first sold in 1951, was a creamy version of ''[[Gianduja (chocolate)|gianduja]]'' called ''Supercrema gianduja'', based on Ferrero's father [[Pietro Ferrero|Pietro]]'s solid chocolate ''Pasta Gianduja''.<ref>{{cite web |first=Adriel |last=Carridice |url=http://www.nutellausa.com/history3.htm |title=The History of Nutella (3) |website=NutellaUSA.com |access-date=2013-01-28 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150518022437/http://www.nutellausa.com/history3.htm |archive-date=18 May 2015}}</ref> In 1964, Ferrero recruited Rivella for them to work together on developing a revamped version of ''Supercrema gianduja'', with the aim of selling it across Italy and Europe.<ref>{{cite web|first=Adriel |last=Carridice |url=http://www.nutellausa.com/history2.htm |title=The History of Nutella (2) |website=NutellaUSA.com |access-date=2013-01-28|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20151021173432/http://www.nutellausa.com/history2.htm|archive-date=21 October 2015}}</ref> Rivella was credited with coming up with the name "Nutella" in 1964,<ref name="10play">{{Cite web|url=https://10play.com.au/theproject/articles/inventor-of-nutella-francesco-rivella-dies-aged-97/tpa250218wjghz|title=Inventor Of Nutella, Francesco Rivella, Dies Aged 97|date=18 February 2025|website=10 play}}</ref> having reportedly perfected the taste with Ferrero after having spent several years with him travelling the world to come up with newer flavours.<ref name="10play" />

Rivella and Ferrero traveled around the world to sample [[confectionery]] products with a belief that they could refine and improve those products. Rivella contributed to the development of [[Kinder (brand)|Kinder]] and [[Ferrero Rocher]] products. According to [[Gigi Padovani]], his balance of tradition and innovation made Rivella a key person in the Ferrero company's rise as a [[multinational company]].<ref>{{Cite web |work=The Express Tribune |title=Francesco Rivella, father of Nutella, dies at 97 after shaping Ferrero’s iconic chocolate and spread |url=https://tribune.com.pk/story/2529299/francesco-rivella-father-of-nutella-dies-at-97-after-shaping-ferreros-iconic-chocolate-and-spread?amp=1}}</ref>

Following his career at Ferrero, Rivella served as a member of the Order of Chemists.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://uk.news.yahoo.com/inventor-food-cupboards-dies-aged-121604225.html?guccounter=1|title=Inventor of food we all have in our cupboards dies, aged 97|date=17 February 2025|website=Yahoo News}}</ref> After retiring, he dedicated his spare time to fruit farming and the traditional Italian sport of [[Pallapugno]].<ref name="fox" /> Rivella died in [[Alba, Piedmont|Alba]], Piedmont, on 14 February 2025, at the age of 97.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.timesnownews.com/world/us/us-buzz/man-behind-your-favourite-nutella-has-died-who-was-francesco-rivella-article-118338420|title=Man Behind Your Favourite Nutella Has Died: Who Was Francesco Rivella|date=18 February 2025|website=Times Now|access-date=18 February 2025|archive-date=18 February 2025|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250218000132/https://www.timesnownews.com/world/us/us-buzz/man-behind-your-favourite-nutella-has-died-who-was-francesco-rivella-article-118338420|url-status=live}}</ref> Prior to his death, Rivella was widowed with three sons, a daughter, and seven grandchildren.<ref>{{Cite magazine   |date=18 February 2025 |title=The legacy of Francesco Rivella, the chemist who invented Nutella |url=https://www.tapasmagazine.es/en/the-legacy-of-francesco-rivella-the-chemist-who-invented-nutella/ |access-date=19 February 2025 |website=Tapas |language=en-US}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=16 February 2025 |title=The Chemist Behind Ferrero's Success |url=https://www.ilmessaggero.it/en/the_chemist_behind_ferrero_s_success-8661462.html |access-date=19 February 2025 |newspaper=[[Il Messaggero]]  |language=en}}</ref>
